name: Camping Jochum
beschreibung: Campingplatz Jochum is located in the village of Jochberg in the district of Kitzbühel in Tirol. The Kitzbüheler Alpen surround the site with a typical mountain landscape. The surroundings offer access to marked hiking trails and cycling routes. In winter, the nearby ski areas Kitzbühel and Pass Thurn make the region accessible. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a bread roll service and a restaurant. Guests stay on pitches for motorhomes and caravans. The atmosphere at the site is described as quiet and family-friendly.
